polymarket.question: Will Donald Trump win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
polymarket.rules_excerpt: The 2028 US Presidential Election is scheduled to take place on November 7, 2028. This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election. The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. review.note: Kalshi pays on who is next inaugurated as President for the term beginning in 2029; Polymarket pays on who wins the election as called by AP, Fox News and NBC, and falls back to the inauguration only if the three do not agree. A candidate who wins the election and is not inaugurated (death, withdrawal, a disputed certification) pays YES on Polymarket and NO on Kalshi. A basket over this pair loses both legs instead of hedging.
